contexts.text: When the goods and truths of faith are perverted by natural lumen, as they call it, it is described... by the feet and hoofs of a beast, by which the waters are disturbed, and with which foods are trampled on; as in ... The feet and hoofs, by which the streams and waters are troubled, = scientifics from sensuous and natural things, from which they reason concerning the arcana of faith...

The hoofs of the horses () = scientifics which pervert truth. ( = the lowest intellectual things, such as are scientifics from mere sensuous things. AC 3727:8.) ( = falsities. AC 7729:4.) ( = the outermost natural things, which are merely sensuous scientifics. AC 10227:12.) ( = the outermost things of the natural man, which are called sensuous things, from which come all Falsities. AE 355:16.) ( = the fallacies of the sensuous man. AE 652:16.)

The hoofs of the horses () = natural truths. ( = falsity in the ultimate degree. AC 7729:2.) ( = sensuous scientifics from a perverted Intellectual. AC 8215:3.) ( = the ultimates of the understanding; here, of a perverted understanding... AE 355:32.)

The hoof (of Pegasus with which he broke open the fountain) meant what is natural. ( = truth of the ultimate degree, where is the origin of intelligence. AC 7729:6.) ( = what is scientific from the understanding. WH 4.) ( = the experiences by which comes natural intelligence. CL 182:2.)
The beating sound of the hoofs of the horses () = the lowest scientifics, which are immediately from sensuous things. ( = the open combat of falsity against truth. AC 7729:3.)

Not a hoof shall be left () = that nothing of truth from good shall be absent. A hoof = truth from good... In the proximate internal sense, by not a hoof shall be left, is signified that nothing whatever shall be absent, because the hoof is common to all beasts; but, in the interior sense, by a hoof is signified truth in the ultimate degree; thus sensuous truth, which is the lowest; and, in the opposite sense, falsity. The reason this is signified by a hoof, is that by a foot is signified what is natural; and by the sole of the foot, the ultimate of the Natural... The like is signified by a hoof, because it is the sole of the foot of beasts. And as the ultimate of the Natural is signified by a hoof... there is also signified the truth which is the ultimate of the Natural...
That by a hoof, especially that of horses, is signified truth in the ultimate degree, thus sensuous truth; and, in the opposite sense, the falsity of the same degree. Illustrated.
The hoof of beast () = falsity in the ultimate of the Natural, which disturbs scientific truth.
Hoof () = truth from good in the ultimate degree. ( = the ultimates there, which are called sensuous scientifics. AE 176:end.) ( = truths in ultimates. AE 316:12.)
To cleave asunder the hoofs () = to turn truth into falsity.
